value.text: PR #1348 review follow-up: the host SDK now keys settings retries by registered command and operation ID; completed retries do not re-run extension code. Settings mutations use the standard serializer and emit onWrite after changed writes. Focused unit and installed-extension integration tests exercise cross-command IDs, legacy format and collection normalization, and hook behavior. pm-test-audit: each case checks externally observable state or history and would fail against the reviewed implementation; no implementation-only assertions or duplicated happy-path coverage.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: SDK surface review: the replay receipt now exposes an explicit replay variant with no callback-derived result, and createExtensionCommandSdk accepts optional command context. sdk/public-surface.json records both signatures with a breaking-change acknowledgement because the snapshot classifier treats signature changes conservatively; existing three-argument callers remain executable.
